entries.text: BCN means Barcelona
barca means Barcelona
lisboa means Lisbon
long weekend means a 3-night stay starting Friday
weekend means a 2-night stay starting Saturday
a week means a 7-night stay
family of N means 2 adults plus N-2 children
couple means 2 adults
solo means 1 adult
early <month> means the first week of that month
mid <month> means the second or third week of that month
late <month> means the last week of that month
Easter weekend in 2027 falls on April 16-19
Memorial Day weekend in 2026 is May 22-25
Christmas week is December 21-28
Thanksgiving week 2026 is November 23-29
with my dog or with our dog implies pets=1 and the pet-friendly tag
beachfront, oceanfront, seaside imply the beachfront tag
downtown, city center, central imply the city-center tag
quiet, peaceful, secluded, off-grid imply the quiet tag
